standard_prerequisites.use: Reductions of schemes, finite universal homeomorphisms, flatness and finite presentation, and generic fibres; the construction is retained.

core_obligations: Choose the nonempty open and pass to the reduction of the base change, identifying the map from the reduction as a finite universal homeomorphism.
Verify the eight listed properties, in particular flatness and finite presentation of the reduced morphism and geometric reducedness of its generic fibre.

proof_roadmap.step: Choose the open of the base and form the base change.
Pass to the reduction and identify the universal homeomorphism.
Verify flatness, finite presentation and the generic-fibre condition.

difficulty_reason: Over an irreducible base and for a finite type morphism, the lemma constructs a diagram in which a nonempty open of the base is replaced by a finite universal homeomorphism and the base-changed morphism is replaced by its reduction, such that the new morphism is flat and of finite presentation with geometrically reduced generic fibre. The proof passes to the reduction, which makes the generic fibre geometrically reduced by construction, and then verifies that the reduction map is a finite universal homeomorphism and that flatness and finite presentation hold over the chosen open. Combining the reduction with the flatness condition is the load-bearing part. Retained author proof at lines 6742-6769.
